definitions.explanation: A single grain of cooked rice, the kind that sticks to a bowl, chopsticks or one's face.

examples.japanese: ⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ご{飯粒|はんつぶ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ついてる⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
examples.english: You've got a grain of rice by your mouth.

examples.japanese: ご{飯粒|はんつぶ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一粒|ひとつぶ}→一粒：27642_hitotsubu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{残|のこ}さ→残す：01975_nokosu⟧ず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: I ate every last grain of rice.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ころ、ご{飯粒|はんつぶ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{残|のこ}す→残す：01975_nokosu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧「⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{潰|つぶ}れる→潰れる：04249_tsubureru⟧」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{言|い}われた→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: When I was a child, my grandmother often told me I'd go blind if I left grains of rice in my bowl.

notes:
Children in Japan are taught not to leave a single grain in the bowl, out of respect for the farmers' work. In the past, mashed rice grains were also used as glue.
